name: Codex CLI
description: Installs the Codex CLI for the container user and stores the EDAG Codex config in the image; the feature's own postCreateCommand hook heals a missing CLI and rewrites the Kelpie base URL per detected mode at container create.

version.description: Codex CLI release passed to the native installer ("latest" follows the current upstream release, e.g. "0.46.0").

configUrl.description: URL of a Codex config.toml to fetch into /opt/edag/codex-config.reference.toml. Empty string (default) skips the fetch and stores this feature's bundled EDAG config.toml.
